title: Overnight R1 on US index CFDs as a bf + P6 sleeve
why: Gen149 set 2 (CFDs) passed on its own; Gen149's follow-up condition required both sets, which failed, so this is a separate, additional trial
sleeve: US100, US500, US30 Dukascopy hourly on the bf grid; signal on 15:00 ET prices (close of the 14:00 bar), IBS range from bars 09:00-14:00; long 0.25 x mean indicator from the bar opening at 16:00 ET until the bar opening at 10:00 ET next day; 1 bp per side (also 2 bp reported)
